privacy.retention.title: Content deletion and retention
privacy.retention.strong: Deletion hides content; retention periods are not yet enforced
privacy.retention.body1: Deleted messages appear as placeholders and their content, reactions, and attachments are hidden. Picom does not currently run an automatic production purge. Limited tombstones, moderation records, immutable audit events, and backups follow separate review and retention paths. Deleted accounts use a “Deleted User” fallback where historical context must remain.
privacy.retention.body2: Final retention periods and legal copy are pending privacy/legal approval. Clearing desktop cache does not delete server data; use Account data controls for export or deletion requests.
privacy.safetyTips.title: Safety tips
privacy.safetyTips.hint: Do not share passwords, tokens, recovery codes, or private invite links. Report suspicious behavior from message/member context actions.
